svg.title: Replicator: you specify it, you build it
svg.desc: A night workshop floor. On the left, the Replicator title, the tagline, a specify prompt being typed and the pipeline blueprint, program, manifold3d, build. On the right a turbofan engine floats in an exploded view while a scan plane sweeps across it, turning the cyan blueprint wireframe into solid coloured parts: intake cowl, compressor, turbine stage and nozzle.
svg.text: You specify it, you build it.
your models · editable at every step · STEP / DXF / STL / 3MF / URDF · agents over MCP
